text.text:
Hello Dear Reader,
To Whom It May Concern,

This is being written under the heading of TSG2199--

However, it is being written on behalf of TSG & Co's dear friend (and separate artist). Who is the artist you might ask? Her name is Beverly Jane, and she has a twin older brother - CBM. Together, TSG2199, Beverly Jane, and CBM write this honest google review of Music Promo Today. We are just friends hanging out and speaking the truth!

TSG is being launched with a mission and a dream. Beverly Jane is the artist behind the vision. Beverly Jane's support outside of her older twin brother? Music Promo Today. Beverly Jane simply could not launch without the help of the Dream Team at Music Promo Today. To be honest, Beverly Jane could not have done it without the expertise, the professionalism, and the support of the incredible team she has worked with.

TSG & Co, Beverly Jane, and CBM, both believe that music should be more like therapy. We believe that music should be accessible to all people, and that music heals the inner person of the heart and mind. This should not be about fame, money, and power. No, music is art - and artists love to perform. Don't they? Beverly Jane and CBM sure do!

What Raffi and Anto created with their business is a brand that has chosen to give a listening ear to the community of music. Alongside their vision, you have the incredible team of Rob Vega, Ani Poghosyan, and Angelika D. This team is full of support, professionalism, guidance, and craftsmanship. Their dedication to their craft and hard work ethic shines in what they can accomplish in a mere two months. We have proof!

To be a part of their roster, is to be a part of a team.

We truly feel honored, appreciated, respected, and guided.

Thank you to Music Promo Today for all that they do. What a great team to work with!

Sincerely,
Your Friends -
TSG & Co, CBM, & Beverly Jane
